children: has committed about 50 million tons per annum of LNG production to 20-year contracts, the company's chief executive said on Monday.
Mike Sabel said at a conference in Bangkok that the company needed to bring shorter-length supply contracts into its portfolio.
"We'll continue to do 20-year contracts, but we're going to start doing more middle term contracts," he said.
